newsitem.title: USA: Baker Fentress Q2 net asset value up,shr off.
newsitem.headline: Baker Fentress Q2 net asset value up,shr off.

text.p: Baker, Fentress & Co said Monday its total net assets as of June 30 rose to $791.31 million from $771.58 million a year ago, but per-share net asset value was $23.25 based on 34.04 million shares, down from $23.81 based on 32.40 million shares.
For the second quarter ended June 30, net investment income rose to $3.18 million or $0.09 a share from $54.65 million or nil a share.
For the first half of the year, net investment income rose to $7.81 million or $0.23 a share from $2.56 million or $0.08 a share.
All 1997 per-share data is after a $1.78 long-term capital gain distribution paid in December 1996.
